缺失会直接造成越权、凭证泄露或无法追责: Absence directly causes unauthorized access, credential leakage, or an inability to assign accountability
主流企业安全评审会要求的能力: Capabilities that mainstream enterprise security reviews require
纵深防御和精细治理: Defense in depth and fine-grained governance
每个请求都要确定两个身份：发起的人和执行的 Agent。两者都由平台从可信来源得: Every request shall determine two identities: the initiating person and the executing agent. Both are derived by the platform from trusted sources; identities self-reported by the request or the model are not accepted.
谁在发起，哪个 Agent 在执行: Who is initiating, and which agent is executing
An agent's permission upper limit comes from the person it represents, not from credentials held by the platform itself. Effective permissions take the intersection per 3.14, and can only be narrowed along the delegation chain.
代表谁，权限上限是多少: On whose behalf, and what is the upper limit of permissions
每一次工具调用在执行前都要经过平台的策略检查。能不能做、要不要人确认，由平台按工: Every tool invocation shall pass the platform's policy check before execution. Whether it may be performed and whether a human must confirm are determined by the platform based on the tool and its parameters; the model's statements do not count.
这一次操作能不能做，要不要人确认: Can this operation be performed, and does it require human confirmation
出口网关是 Agent 访问下游系统和互联网的唯一通道，真实凭证只在这里注入。没: The egress gateway is the only channel through which agents access downstream systems and the internet, and real credentials are injected only there. With no path that bypasses the gateway, and credentials sent only to their authorized targets, the guarantee against leakage holds.
请求怎么出去，凭证怎么注入: How requests leave, and how credentials are injected
Agent 执行代码、命令、浏览器和端侧操作时，要被限定在可控的边界内。Harn: When agents execute code, commands, browsers, and endpoint operations, they shall be confined within controllable boundaries. The enterprise shall also centrally control the harness's own configuration, which employees or code repositories may not rewrite at will.
代码、命令、浏览器和扩展在什么边界内运行: Within what boundaries code, commands, browsers, and extensions run
进入上下文的不可信内容只能当作数据，不能当作指令。会话读入不可信内容之后，Age: Untrusted content entering the context may be treated only as data, never as instructions. After a session reads untrusted content, the actions the agent can take shall be tightened accordingly.
读进来的内容能不能影响决策: Can content that was read in influence decisions
权限检查要延伸到输出的那一刻。结果给谁看、会不会外泄，都要按接收方再判断一次。: Permission checks shall extend to the moment of output. To whom results are shown, and whether they could leak, shall be judged again for each recipient.
结果给谁看，会不会外泄: To whom are results shown, and could they be leaked
Agent 留下的东西会被后来的人检索到。检索、记忆和产出物都要带着来源和权限标: What agents leave behind may be retrieved later by others. Retrieval, memory, and output artifacts shall carry source and permission labels, and authorization shall be re-determined for the current user at read time.
数据怎么检索、沉淀和留存: How data is retrieved, accumulated, and retained
每个 Agent 都要有登记、有负责人、有复核，从创建到下线全程可管。平台提供方: Every agent shall have registration, an owner, and periodic review, and shall be governed from creation to decommissioning. Access by the platform provider itself is also within the scope of governance.
谁管 Agent，从登记到下线: Who manages agents, from registration to decommissioning
出了事，要能还原谁让哪个 Agent 基于什么内容做了什么，并能在分钟级别内止损: When an incident occurs, it shall be possible to reconstruct which agent did what, on whose behalf, and based on what content, and to contain the damage within minutes. This chapter covers recording, detection, revocation, emergency deactivation, and post-incident recovery.
怎么记录、发现和止损: How activity is recorded, discovered, and contained
支持 IM、邮件、浏览器插件等第三方渠道的平台: Platforms that support third-party channels such as IM, email, and browser extensions
为会话分配独立执行实例（如容器、沙箱或虚拟机）的平台: Platforms that assign an independent execution instance (such as a container, sandbox, or virtual machine) to each session
向客户或合作伙伴开放 Agent 能力的平台: Platforms that open agent capabilities to customers or partners
代表用户访问: Access on Behalf of a User
支持定时任务或长时任务的平台: Platforms that support scheduled or long-running tasks
支持多 Agent 协作或子 Agent 的平台: Platforms that support multi-agent collaboration or sub-agents
用户间委托与临时提权: Inter-User Delegation and Temporary Privilege Elevation
支持用户代他人使用 Agent，或支持 Agent 临时提权的平台: Platforms that let users operate agents on behalf of others, or that support temporary privilege elevation for agents
支持 Webhook、告警、工单等事件触发 Agent 的平台: Platforms that support agents triggered by events such as webhooks, alerts, or tickets
二次认证与持续访问评估: Step-Up Authentication and Continuous Access Evaluation
存在只支持共享静态凭证的下游系统的平台: Platforms with downstream systems that support only shared static credentials
平台托管的执行环境；在员工终端上运行的 Agent 按 V5.4 执行: Platform-hosted execution environments; agents running on employee endpoints are handled under V5.4
支持代码或命令执行的平台: Platforms that support code or command execution
支持浏览器或桌面操作的平台: Platforms that support browser or desktop operations
在员工终端上运行的 Agent，如编码 Agent、桌面助手: Agents running on employee endpoints, such as coding agents and desktop assistants
Skill、插件与 MCP 供应链: Skill, Plugin, and MCP Supply Chain
支持安装 Skill、插件或第三方 MCP 的平台: Platforms that support installing skills, plugins, or third-party MCP servers
接触不可信内容后的降级: Downgrading After Exposure to Untrusted Content
支持群聊、频道、共享文档评论等多人渠道的平台: Platforms that support multi-party channels such as group chats, channels, and comments on shared documents
多人共用同一个 Agent 的平台: Platforms where multiple people share the same agent
支持会话转交或人工接管的平台: Platforms that support session handover or human takeover
代发消息: Messages Sent on Behalf of a User
支持以用户名义发送邮件、IM 或公告的平台: Platforms that send email, IM messages, or announcements in the user's name
支持 RAG 或知识库检索的平台: Platforms that support RAG or knowledge base retrieval
Agent 直接查询业务数据库的平台: Platforms where agents query business databases directly
支持长期记忆或知识沉淀的平台: Platforms that support long-term memory or knowledge accumulation
接入多个模型的平台。对话数据用于评估和微调属于模型训练的数据治理，参见 OWAS: Platforms that connect to multiple models. Use of conversation data for evaluation and fine-tuning is model training data governance; see OWASP AISVS C1 and C3.
企业 IdP、目录、SCIM，签发用户、Agent 和工作负载身份: Enterprise IdP, directory, and SCIM; issues user, agent, and workload identities
Web、IM、邮件、IDE、API 等入口，负责身份映射和输出的可见范围: Web, IM, email, IDE, API, and other entry points; responsible for identity mapping and the visibility scope of output
可信；经渠道进入的内容不可信: Trusted; content arriving through the channel is untrusted
Agent 循环、上下文管理、工具层、安全控制、编排、扩展接口: Agent loop, context management, tool layer, security controls, orchestration, extension interfaces
平台托管时可信；在员工终端运行时不可信，按 V5.4: Trusted when platform-hosted; untrusted when running on employee endpoints, per V5.4
计算有效权限、判定风险等级、决定是否审批: Computes effective permissions, determines risk levels, and decides whether approval is required
统一出口，注入凭证、校验目标、限流、吊销；凭证库归属于此: Unified egress; injects credentials, validates targets, rate-limits, and revokes; the credential store belongs here
被访问的 SaaS、内部 API、MCP Server、数据库: SaaS, internal APIs, MCP servers, and databases being accessed
自行作出授权判定；返回内容不可信: Makes its own authorization decisions; returned content is untrusted
知识库、RAG、记忆、产出物: Knowledge bases, RAG, memory, output artifacts
可信；存储的内容可能被污染，按不可信内容处理: Trusted; stored content may be poisoned and is handled as untrusted content
执行代码、命令、文件和浏览器操作: Executes code, commands, files, and browser operations
Agent 登记、连接器、托管策略、生命周期: Agent registration, connectors, managed policies, lifecycle
记录、调阅、导出与留存，以及检测与响应: Recording, retrieval, export, and retention, as well as detection and response
渠道账号映射到企业身份: Map channel accounts to enterprise identities
签发工作负载身份，确定用户和 Agent: Issue workload identity; determine user and agent
按有效权限过滤工具清单、记忆和检索结果: Filter tool list, memory, and retrieval results by effective permissions
执行前做策略检查和风险分级: Policy check and risk classification before execution
按真实参数生成审批，必要时二次认证: Generate approval from actual parameters; step-up authentication when necessary
经网关注入凭证、校验目标、限流: Inject credentials through the gateway, validate target, rate-limit
下游按代表用户访问时传递的用户身份作出授权判定: The downstream system makes an authorization decision based on the user identity passed when accessing on behalf of the user
返回内容按不可信处理并标记来源: Treat returned content as untrusted and mark its source
检查接收方、敏感数据和渲染风险: Check recipient, sensitive data, and rendering risk
每一步写入审计，可追溯到人、Agent 和输入来源: Each step is written to audit and traceable to the person, the agent, and the input source
平台及其全部渠道应只允许通过企业 IdP（OIDC 或 SAML）登录，不提供独: The platform and all its channels shall allow login only through the enterprise IdP (OIDC or SAML) and shall not provide independent local accounts, except for the break-glass accounts specified in V10.5
应通过 SCIM 或等效机制同步用户和组，IdP 中禁用的用户在平台中同步禁用: Users and groups shall be synchronized through SCIM or an equivalent mechanism, and users disabled in the IdP shall be disabled in the platform in sync
应在用户会话中保留 IdP 签发的认证时间和认证强度，供 V3.5 的二次认证判: The authentication time and authentication strength issued by the IdP shall be retained in the user session for use in the step-up authentication decisions of V3.5
通过 API 调用 Agent 的凭证（如 API Key、个人访问令牌）应绑定: Credentials used to invoke agents through an API (such as API keys and personal access tokens) shall be bound to a specific user or non-human identity in the enterprise IdP, shall have an expiration time and a permission scope set, and shall become invalid in sync when the identity is disabled
渠道账号应先通过一次 SSO 登录与企业身份绑定，才能调用 Agent: A channel account shall be bound to an enterprise identity through a single SSO login before it can invoke an agent
应以 SSO 绑定结果作为渠道账号的唯一身份依据，不按昵称、显示名或邮箱字符串匹: The SSO binding result shall be the sole basis for identifying a channel account. Matching by nickname, display name, or email string is not permitted. The email channel follows V1.2.6.
IdP 禁用用户后，该用户的全部渠道绑定应同步失效: When a user is disabled in the IdP, all of that user's channel bindings shall be invalidated in sync
应识别外部访客和跨组织共享频道中的账号，并为其单独限定可用的 Agent 和能力: Accounts from external visitors and from cross-organization shared channels shall be identified, and the agents and capabilities available to them shall be restricted separately
在渠道内触发高风险操作时，应要求用户通过企业 IdP 完成二次认证: When a high-risk operation is triggered within a channel, the user shall be required to complete step-up authentication through the enterprise IdP
邮件渠道应只受理通过 DMARC 校验的邮件（SPF 或 DKIM 通过且与发件: The email channel shall accept only email that passes DMARC verification (SPF or DKIM passing and aligned with the From domain). Senders from external domains shall not be able to trigger operations on behalf of a user.
每个 Agent 应有平台签发的唯一身份标识，不采信 Agent 自报的身份: Each agent shall have a unique identifier issued by the platform. The platform shall not accept identities self-reported by the agent.
应为自主 Agent 在企业目录中建立独立的非人类身份，不使用任何员工的个人账号: An independent non-human identity shall be established in the enterprise directory for each autonomous agent. No employee's personal account shall be used.
自主 Agent 访问下游时应使用 V1.3.2 建立的身份，下游日志中记录的主: When an autonomous agent accesses downstream systems, it shall use the identity established under V1.3.2, and the principal recorded in downstream logs shall be that agent
自主 Agent 访问下游应使用短时效令牌，不使用长期静态密钥: When an autonomous agent accesses downstream systems, it shall use short-lived tokens and shall not use long-term static keys
自主 Agent 的密钥和证书应有签发、轮换和吊销流程，轮换周期设上限: The keys and certificates of an autonomous agent shall have processes for issuance, rotation, and revocation, and the rotation period shall have an upper limit
平台应为每个会话的执行实例签发短期工作负载身份，并与该实例绑定: The platform shall issue a short-lived workload identity to the execution instance of each session and bind it to that instance
工作负载身份的凭证应对模型不可见，不进入上下文和工具返回: The credentials of the workload identity shall be invisible to the model and shall not enter the context or tool return values
出口网关应只依据工作负载身份确定用户和 Agent，忽略请求中自报的用户或 Ag: The egress gateway shall determine the user and agent solely from the workload identity and shall ignore user or agent identifiers self-reported in the request
会话结束或执行实例销毁时，应立即吊销对应的工作负载身份: When a session ends or an execution instance is destroyed, the corresponding workload identity shall be revoked immediately
平台签发工作负载身份前应对执行实例做工作负载证明（如 SPIFFE/SPIRE: Before issuing a workload identity, the platform shall perform workload attestation on the execution instance (such as node attestation and workload attestation in SPIFFE/SPIRE). The identity shall not be issued if attestation fails.
应通过身份联邦接入外部主体，不为其创建共享账号: External principals shall be accessed through identity federation, and no shared account shall be created for them
外部主体应只能访问为其开放的工作空间和接口: External principals shall be able to access only the workspaces and interfaces open to them
外部主体的调用应单独记录审计，可按外部组织筛选: Invocations by external principals shall be recorded separately in audit and shall be filterable by external organization
用户在场时，Agent 访问下游应携带发起用户的身份，由下游按该用户作出授权判定: When the user is present, an agent accessing downstream systems shall carry the identity of the initiating user, and the downstream system shall make its authorization decision based on that user. Downstream systems that do not support user-level authorization decisions are handled under V4.4.
不应使用权限高于发起用户的共享凭证替用户访问下游，只支持共享静态凭证的下游按 V: Shared credentials with higher permissions than the initiating user shall not be used to access downstream systems on the user's behalf. Downstream systems that support only shared static credentials are handled by compensating controls under V4.4.
下游令牌应同时标识发起用户和执行的 Agent（如 RFC 8693 的 act: Downstream tokens shall identify both the initiating user and the executing agent (such as the act claim in RFC 8693)
每次调用的有效权限应取用户权限与 Agent 授权范围的交集: The effective permissions of each invocation shall be the intersection of the user's permissions and the agent authorization scope
有效权限应由策略决策点计算，不依赖系统提示词或模型的判断: Effective permissions shall be computed by the policy decision point and shall not depend on the system prompt or on the model's judgment
任务开始时应声明所需的工具和数据范围，运行中只授予声明范围内的权限；声明由用户或: At the start of a task, the required tool and data scope shall be declared. During execution, only permissions within the declared scope shall be granted. The declaration is provided by the user or by agent configuration, and any scope proposed by the model shall take effect only after user confirmation.
超出任务声明范围的调用应被拒绝或转为审批: Invocations beyond the task's declared scope shall be rejected or converted to approval
有效权限应在每次工具调用时重新计算，不沿用会话开始时的授权结果: Effective permissions shall be recomputed on each tool invocation and shall not reuse the authorization result from the start of the session
高风险操作的授权应细化到具体资源和参数（如用 RFC 9396 RAR 描述授权: Authorization for high-risk operations shall be refined to specific resources and parameters (for example, using RFC 9396 Rich Authorization Requests to describe the authorization details) and shall not grant only coarse-grained roles
离线委托任务应以创建用户为根，创建时固定权限上限，之后只能收窄: An offline delegated task shall be rooted in its creating user. The permission upper limit shall be fixed at creation and can only be narrowed thereafter.
每次运行前应复查创建用户的账号状态和当前权限: The account status and current permissions of the creating user shall be rechecked before each run
调度器应只保存任务标识，不保存用户凭证或可直接使用的令牌: The scheduler shall store only task identifiers and shall not store user credentials or directly usable tokens
创建用户被禁用后，其离线委托任务应自动停止并通知该 Agent 的负责人: When the creating user is disabled, their offline delegated tasks shall stop automatically, and the owner of the agent shall be notified
创建用户离职或转岗后仍需继续运行的任务，应在其账号禁用前转为自主 Agent，并: For tasks that must continue running after the creating user leaves or changes roles, the tasks shall be converted to autonomous agents and reauthorized through approval before the user's account is disabled
离线委托任务的授权应设到期时间，到期后需创建用户重新确认: The authorization for an offline delegated task shall have an expiration time, after which the creating user must reconfirm it
下游 Agent 的有效权限不应超过发起用户的权限与上游的委托范围，发起用户不能: The effective permissions of a downstream agent shall not exceed the permissions of the initiating user or the delegation scope of the upstream. The initiating user shall not obtain, through a downstream agent, permissions that the user does not hold.
Harness 派生的子 Agent，可用工具和权限应是父 Agent 的子集: For sub-agents derived by the harness, the available tools and permissions shall be a subset of those of the parent agent
委托链应由平台构建和记录，不采信未经平台或可信授权服务器签名的身份声明: The delegation chain shall be constructed and recorded by the platform. Identity assertions not signed by the platform or by a trusted authorization server shall not be accepted.
应显式配置哪些 Agent 可以调用哪些 Agent，未配置的调用被拒绝: Which agents may invoke which other agents shall be explicitly configured. Invocations that are not configured shall be rejected.
应限制委托链深度，并检测和阻断循环调用: The depth of the delegation chain shall be limited, and circular invocations shall be detected and blocked
多跳委托时，下游令牌应携带完整的执行者链（如 RFC 8693 中嵌套的 act: In multi-hop delegation, downstream tokens shall carry the complete executor chain (such as nested act claims in RFC 8693) so that downstream systems can make authorization decisions accordingly
在同一信任域内跨服务调用时，应沿调用链传递携带用户、Agent 和任务上下文的令: For cross-service invocations within the same trust domain, tokens carrying user, agent, and task context shall be propagated along the call chain (such as the Transaction Tokens draft), so that downstream systems can make authorization decisions accordingly
用户允许他人代为使用自己的 Agent 时（如助理代主管），应显式登记委托关系，: When a user permits others to operate the user's agent on their behalf (for example, an assistant acting for a manager), the delegation relationship shall be explicitly registered, with a defined scope and period
代为操作时，审计应同时记录委托人和实际操作人: When operating on behalf of another person, audit shall record both the principal and the person who actually performed the operation
Agent 需要超出其授权范围的权限时，应经申请和审批限时授予，到期自动收回: When an agent requires permissions beyond its authorization scope, they shall be granted for a limited time through request and approval, and they shall be withdrawn automatically upon expiry
入站事件应校验签名和来源，未通过校验的事件被拒绝: Inbound events shall have their signatures and sources verified, and events that fail verification shall be rejected
每条触发规则应绑定执行身份，即自主 Agent 的身份或规则配置人的身份: Each trigger rule shall be bound to an execution identity, namely the identity of an autonomous agent or the identity of the person who configured the rule
触发规则的创建和修改应记录审计，并标明配置人: The creation and modification of trigger rules shall be recorded in audit and shall identify the person who configured them
应为每个工具标注操作类别（至少区分读取、写入、删除、外发、资金操作和生产变更）和: Each tool shall be labeled with an operation category (distinguishing at least read, write, delete, outbound transfer, fund operation, and production change) and a risk level
风险等级应由平台按工具和参数判定，不采用模型给出的风险评估: The risk level shall be determined by the platform based on the tool and its parameters, and shall not adopt the risk assessment given by the model
每个风险等级应对应确定的处置方式，如自动执行、事后通知、事前审批、二次认证或拒绝: Each risk level shall correspond to a defined disposition, such as automatic execution, after-the-fact notification, prior approval, step-up authentication, or rejection
同一工具在影响范围不同的参数下（如删除 1 条与批量删除）应能落入不同等级: The same tool, under parameters with different scopes of impact (such as deleting one record versus bulk deletion), shall be able to fall into different levels
每次工具调用执行前都应经过策略检查，检查在 Agent 无法修改的组件中执行（平: Every tool invocation shall pass a policy check before execution. The check shall run in a component that the agent cannot modify (a platform-hosted harness, the policy decision point, or the egress gateway). Authorization decisions shall not adopt the output of the model used by the agent being checked.
安全约束应由策略执行点（Harness 或出口网关）按策略决策点的决定强制执行，: Security constraints shall be enforced by the policy enforcement point (the harness or the egress gateway) according to the decisions of the policy decision point, and they shall not exist only in the system prompt
前置检查的策略和钩子应由平台下发，Agent 自身不能修改或绕过: The policies and hooks for pre-execution checks shall be distributed by the platform, and the agent itself shall not be able to modify or bypass them
策略检查出错或超时时应默认拒绝: When a policy check errors or times out, the default shall be to deny
策略决策点应通过标准化授权接口（如 OpenID AuthZEN）与策略执行点交: The policy decision point shall interact with the policy enforcement point through a standardized authorization interface (such as OpenID AuthZEN) to facilitate replacement of the policy engine
交给模型的工具清单应按当前有效权限过滤，模型看不到无权使用的工具: The tool list provided to the model shall be filtered by current effective permissions, so that the model cannot see tools it is not authorized to use
工具清单裁剪之外，执行前仍应按 V3.2 校验: Beyond trimming the tool list, V3.2 validation shall still be applied before execution
高风险操作应在执行前取得有权批准该操作的人批准；未列入双人控制的操作可由发起用户: High-risk operations shall be approved, before execution, by a person authorized to approve them. Operations not subject to dual control may be approved by the initiating user.
审批内容应由平台根据真实调用参数生成，不使用模型撰写的摘要: Approval content shall be generated by the platform from the actual invocation parameters and shall not use a summary written by the model
执行时应校验实际参数与审批时一致，不一致则拒绝；按 V3.4.6 事先批准的计划: At execution, the actual parameters shall be verified to match those at approval, and execution shall be rejected if they do not match. For invocations executed under a pre-approved plan per V3.4.6, the invocation shall be verified to be within the plan's scope.
审批应设有效期，过期未批视为拒绝: Approvals shall have a validity period, and an approval request that expires without a decision shall be treated as rejected
应限制审批请求的频率并合并同类请求，防止审批疲劳: The frequency of approval requests shall be limited and similar requests shall be merged to prevent approval fatigue
应支持事先批准的执行计划，写明工具、资源范围和上限；计划范围内的操作不再逐次审批: Pre-approved execution plans shall be supported, specifying tools, resource scope, and limits. Operations within the plan's scope are not approved individually each time. Operations exceeding the scope shall be aborted and reapproved.
资金、生产变更、批量删除等操作应要求用户完成二次认证（如重新完成 MFA）: Operations such as fund transfers, production changes, and bulk deletion shall require the user to complete step-up authentication (such as re-completing MFA)
平台应接收 IdP 的会话风险信号（如 CAEP），风险升高时降低 Agent: The platform shall receive session risk signals from the IdP (such as CAEP). When risk rises, it shall lower the level of operations the agent may perform or suspend the agent.
互斥职责（如提交与审批、开发与上线）不应分配给同一个 Agent: Mutually exclusive duties (such as submission and approval, or development and release) shall not be assigned to the same agent
对按职责分离要求双人控制的操作（如付款、生产变更、权限授予），审批人不应是发起人: For operations that require dual control under separation of duties (such as payments, production changes, and permission grants), the approver shall not be the initiator, nor an agent acting on the initiator's behalf
Agent 创建或修改定时任务、触发规则、Webhook、转发规则和 Skill: When an agent creates or modifies scheduled tasks, trigger rules, webhooks, forwarding rules, or skills, they shall take effect only after user approval
由 Agent 创建的全部持久化对象应能在管理面集中列出，并标明创建来源: All persistent objects created by an agent shall be listable centrally in the management plane, and shall indicate their source of creation
应按用户、Agent 和操作类型设置速率、批量和导出上限: Rate, bulk, and export limits shall be set by user, agent, and operation type
超出上限的请求应被拦截并告警: Requests exceeding limits shall be blocked and alerted
应按部门、用户或 Agent 设置模型调用预算，超额时暂停或转为审批: Model invocation budgets shall be set by department, user, or agent. When a budget is exceeded, the invocations shall be paused or converted to approval.
每次 Agent 运行应设置最大工具调用次数、最长运行时长和最大模型调用开销，由: Each agent run shall have a maximum number of tool invocations, a maximum run duration, and a maximum model invocation cost, enforced by the platform. When a limit is reached, the run shall be aborted and the initiator or owner notified.
访问下游所需的令牌和密钥应由平台托管，平台托管的执行环境、上下文和模型中只出现占: Tokens and keys required to access downstream systems shall be held by the platform. Only placeholder credentials shall appear in platform-hosted execution environments, in the context, and in the model, except for the cases specified in V5.2.2.
每个托管凭证应绑定允许的目标域名和路径，网关只在目标匹配时注入真实凭证: Each managed credential shall be bound to permitted target domain names and paths, and the gateway shall inject the real credential only when the target matches
网关不应把凭证注入 URL 或查询参数；非 HTTP 协议的认证应由网关或平台侧: The gateway shall not inject credentials into URLs or query parameters. Authentication for non-HTTP protocols shall be completed by the gateway or a platform-side proxy, and credentials shall not enter the execution environment.
目标不匹配的替换请求应被拒绝并告警: Substitution requests whose target does not match shall be rejected and alerted
下游响应中回显的凭证应在返回执行环境前被剔除: Credentials echoed in downstream responses shall be stripped before the response is returned to the execution environment
平台应提供托管授权流程（如 OAuth），用户无需把个人凭证或 API Key: The platform shall provide a managed authorization flow (such as OAuth), so that users do not need to hand personal credentials or API keys directly to the agent
对话和上传文件中出现的凭证应被识别，并阻止其写入记忆、产出物或 Agent 配置: Credentials appearing in conversations and uploaded files shall be identified, and their writing into memory, output artifacts, or agent configuration shall be blocked
Agent 对执行环境之外的全部访问应只经过出口网关: All of an agent's access outside the execution environment shall pass only through the egress gateway
执行环境的网络应默认拒绝出站，只放行出口网关: Network egress from the execution environment shall be denied by default, and only the egress gateway shall be permitted
内网服务和数据库应拒绝来自执行环境网段、绕过网关的直连: Internal network services and databases shall reject direct connections from the execution environment's network segment that bypass the gateway
应定期扫描执行环境、Agent 配置和镜像中的硬编码凭证: Hard-coded credentials in the execution environment, agent configurations, and images shall be scanned periodically
平台应维护已登记的下游系统清单（地址、所属系统和数据级别），出口网关据此区分企业: The platform shall maintain an inventory of registered downstream systems (addresses, owning systems, and data classification), against which the egress gateway distinguishes intra-enterprise access from outbound transfer
访问第三方 SaaS 时，应取得用户级授权（由用户本人完成 OAuth 授权，或: When accessing third-party SaaS, user-level authorization shall be obtained, either by the user completing OAuth authorization personally or by exchanging for a user-level token through the enterprise IdP. Shared application credentials across users shall not be used.
用户撤销授权后，平台应立即停止使用对应凭证: When a user revokes authorization, the platform shall immediately stop using the corresponding credential
下游支持令牌交换时，应通过企业 IdP 按 RFC 8693，或按基于 RFC: When a downstream system supports token exchange, a user-level short-lived token shall be obtained through the enterprise IdP per RFC 8693, or through ID-JAG based on RFC 8693 and RFC 7523
遗留系统的共享密钥应由平台托管，不下发到执行环境: Shared secrets of legacy systems shall be held by the platform and shall not be distributed to the execution environment
网关应按用户在接口级和操作级作出授权判定，弥补下游缺失的用户级授权: The gateway shall make user-level authorization decisions at the interface and operation levels to compensate for the lack of user-level authorization in the downstream system
网关应向下游附带签名的用户身份信息，供下游校验和逐步改造: The gateway shall attach a signed user identity to downstream requests so that downstream systems can verify it and progressively adopt user-level authorization
应登记由网关代为作出用户级授权判定的下游系统，并纳入定期复核: Downstream systems for which the gateway makes user-level authorization decisions on their behalf shall be registered and included in periodic review
远程 MCP Server 的请求应经过出口网关，并携带用户身份: Requests to remote MCP servers shall pass through the egress gateway and carry the user identity
平台自建或托管的 MCP Server 不应持有供所有用户共用的长期凭证: MCP servers built or hosted by the platform shall not hold long-term credentials shared by all users
本地运行的 MCP 进程应同样只获得占位凭证，出网受执行环境的网络策略约束: Locally running MCP processes shall likewise obtain only placeholder credentials, and their outbound network access shall be constrained by the execution environment's network policy
支持 Enterprise-Managed Authorization 扩展的: MCP servers that support the Enterprise-Managed Authorization extension shall be connected with authorization through the enterprise IdP
平台自建或托管的 MCP Server 应只接受签发给自身的令牌（校验签发方和受: MCP servers built or hosted by the platform shall accept only tokens issued to themselves (verifying the issuer and audience, for example using the RFC 8707 resource indicator), and shall not pass received tokens through to downstream APIs
平台应保存已审核 MCP Server 的工具定义快照，工具名称、描述或参数结构: The platform shall retain a snapshot of the tool definitions of reviewed MCP servers. After any change in tool name, description, or parameter structure, the changed tools shall not be exposed to the model until they are reviewed again.
网关注入或换取的下游令牌应设置短有效期: Downstream tokens injected or exchanged by the gateway shall have a short validity period
对支持的下游，令牌应采用发送方绑定（DPoP 或 mTLS），防止被盗后重放: For supported downstream systems, tokens shall be sender-constrained (DPoP or mTLS) to prevent replay after theft
令牌应限定受众（audience），只能用于签发时指定的下游: Tokens shall be restricted to an audience and shall be usable only with the downstream system specified at issuance
托管凭证应加密存储，数据库和备份中不出现明文: Managed credentials shall be stored encrypted, and no plaintext shall appear in databases or backups
平台管理员和运维人员不应能读取或导出凭证明文: Platform administrators and operations personnel shall not be able to read or export plaintext credentials
只有出口网关能在调用时取用凭证，每次取用都应记录审计: Only the egress gateway shall be able to retrieve credentials at invocation time, and each retrieval shall be recorded in audit
主密钥应由企业控制的 KMS 或 HSM 管理: The master key shall be managed by a KMS or HSM controlled by the enterprise
应支持按用户、按连接或全量批量轮换和吊销凭证: Credentials shall be rotatable and revocable per user, per connection, or in bulk
每个会话应使用独立的执行环境，不同用户之间、同一用户的不同会话之间不共享文件和进: Each session shall use an independent execution environment. Files and processes shall not be shared between different users, or between different sessions of the same user.
执行环境应以非特权身份运行，不能访问宿主机或其他实例: The execution environment shall run under an unprivileged identity and shall not be able to access the host or other instances
会话结束后应销毁执行环境及其中的文件和临时凭证: After a session ends, the execution environment and its files and temporary credentials shall be destroyed
多个用户或租户共享宿主机的执行环境，应采用独立内核或用户态内核隔离，如 gVis: Where multiple users or tenants share a host's execution environment, independent kernel or user-space kernel isolation shall be used, such as gVisor, Kata Containers, or Firecracker microVMs
代码和命令应只在隔离的执行环境中运行，不在 Harness 或平台宿主上直接执行: Code and commands shall run only in an isolated execution environment, and not directly on the harness or on the platform host
无法由出口网关注入的凭证（如需在客户端签名的云 API 凭证），应按用户和任务签: Credentials that cannot be injected by the egress gateway (such as cloud API credentials that must be signed on the client) shall be issued as short-lived credentials (such as AWS STS) scoped to specific permissions and target resources per user and task. Long-term keys shall not be used.
在员工终端或挂载持久数据的执行环境中，删除持久数据、提权和修改网络配置的命令应在: On employee terminals or in execution environments that mount persistent data, commands that delete persistent data, escalate privileges, or modify network configuration shall be converted to approval before execution
依赖包应只能从企业认可的镜像源安装: Dependency packages shall be installable only from enterprise-approved mirror sources
平台提供浏览器环境时，Agent 应使用独立的浏览器配置，不复用用户已登录的个人: When the platform provides a browser environment, the agent shall use an independent browser profile and shall not reuse the user's personal logged-in session
提交会产生外部效果的表单（如下单、付款、发送消息、发布内容、修改账户设置）前应转: Before submitting a form that produces an external effect (such as placing an order, making a payment, sending a message, publishing content, or changing account settings), the operation shall be converted to approval
应逐站点授权 Agent 可访问的网站，未授权站点被拦截: Websites that the agent may access shall be authorized site by site, and unauthorized sites shall be blocked
桌面操作应限定在用户授权的应用范围内: Desktop operations shall be limited to the scope of applications authorized by the user
在用户已登录的浏览器中运行的 Agent（如浏览器插件），应按站点白名单运行，默: An agent running in a browser where the user is logged in (such as a browser extension) shall operate on a site allowlist, shall deny by default any site not on the list, and shall by default be prohibited from operating on identity authentication, payment, and administrative console sites
端侧执行应默认放在系统级沙箱中，如 macOS Seatbelt 或 Linux: Endpoint execution shall by default be placed in a system-level sandbox, such as macOS Seatbelt or Linux bubblewrap
文件访问应按目录授权，默认不能读取密钥目录（如 ~/.ssh、~/.aws）和浏: File access shall be authorized by directory. By default, reading key directories (such as ~/.ssh and ~/.aws) and browser credential stores shall be denied.
在受管终端上，企业应能通过托管策略统一下发端侧策略，员工不能在本机关闭；未受管终: On managed endpoints, the enterprise shall be able to distribute endpoint policies uniformly through managed policy, and employees shall not be able to disable them locally. Endpoint agents on unmanaged endpoints shall not obtain credentials for accessing enterprise resources.
端侧 Agent 访问企业资源应经过出口网关，不直接使用本机保存的企业凭证: Endpoint agents accessing enterprise resources shall pass through the egress gateway and shall not directly use enterprise credentials stored locally
企业应能下发不可被本地配置覆盖的托管策略: The enterprise shall be able to distribute managed policies that cannot be overridden by local configuration
托管策略应能禁止或限制自动批准、跳过确认等模式: Managed policies shall be able to prohibit or restrict modes such as automatic approval and skipping confirmation
允许和禁止的工具清单应由企业统一配置: The lists of permitted and prohibited tools shall be configured centrally by the enterprise
项目目录（代码仓库或 IDE 中打开的工作区）中的规则文件、MCP 定义和钩子，: Rule files, MCP definitions, and hooks in the project directory (a code repository or a workspace opened in an IDE) shall be loaded only after the user confirms trust
项目目录中的上述配置变更后，应重新确认信任才能加载: After the above configuration in the project directory changes, trust shall be reconfirmed before it is loaded
企业应能禁止加载项目目录级的 MCP 和钩子: The enterprise shall be able to prohibit loading of project-directory-level MCP servers and hooks
Skill、插件和 MCP Server 应经审核后才能安装: Skills, plugins, and MCP servers shall be reviewed before they can be installed
管理员应能维护允许安装的白名单，并能立即下架: Administrators shall be able to maintain an allowlist of permitted installations and to withdraw items immediately
应校验来源和签名并锁定版本，更新需重新审核: Source and signatures shall be verified and versions shall be pinned. Updates shall require re-review.
每个 Skill 或插件应声明所需权限，执行时超出声明的调用被拒绝: Each skill or plugin shall declare the permissions it requires, and invocations exceeding the declaration shall be rejected at execution
平台应将工具返回、检索结果、网页、邮件、文件和其他 Agent 的输出记为不可信: The platform shall classify tool return values, retrieval results, web pages, emails, files, and the outputs of other agents as untrusted content, and use this classification as the basis for the tightening rules of V6.2
进入上下文的内容应标记来源，使策略检查能区分用户指令和不可信内容: Content entering the context shall be marked with its source so that policy checks can distinguish user instructions from untrusted content
平台策略和系统提示词应通过消息角色或分隔结构与不可信内容隔开，不拼接在同一段文本: Platform policy and the system prompt shall be separated from untrusted content by message roles or delimiting structures, and shall not be concatenated within the same block of text
会话接触不可信内容后，任何外发都应默认禁止，经审批后方可执行: After a session is exposed to untrusted content, all outbound transfers shall be denied by default and permitted only after approval
After a session is exposed to untrusted content, writes and deletes to systems outside the execution environment shall be converted to approval, or limited to the plan pre-approved under V3.4.6
应定期用嵌入注入指令的网页、邮件、文档和工具返回，对 Agent 做红队测试: Red team tests shall be run periodically against agents, using web pages, emails, documents, and tool return values that embed injected instructions
高风险场景应先由没有工具权限的隔离模型处理不可信内容，只把结构化结果交给有权限的: In high-risk scenarios, untrusted content shall first be processed by an isolated model without tool permissions, and only structured results shall be passed to the agent that has permissions. Examples include the Dual LLM pattern, or CaMeL, which adds separation of control flow and data flow on top of it.
系统提示词、Agent 配置和 Skill 文件中不应包含凭证或密钥: System prompts, agent configurations, and skill files shall not contain credentials or keys
应假定系统提示词可能泄露，其中不应包含个人信息，也不应包含超出该 Agent 全: The system prompt shall be assumed to be possibly leaked. It shall contain no personal information and no data beyond the scope visible to all users of the agent.
Agent 配置和 Skill 文件在发布前应经过凭证扫描: Agent configurations and skill files shall undergo credential scanning before release
Agent 之间的消息应经平台转发并附带发送方身份，Agent 之间不直接通信: Messages between agents shall be forwarded by the platform with the sender's identity attached. Agents shall not communicate directly with each other.
关键节点应校验上游输出的格式和取值范围，不合规的结果不再向下传递: Critical nodes shall validate the format and value range of upstream output, and results that do not conform shall not be passed further downstream
链路中异常输出或错误率超过阈值时，应熔断整条链路并告警: When anomalous output or the error rate in a chain exceeds a threshold, the entire chain shall be circuit-broken and an alert raised
在多人渠道中，回复只能使用全部在场成员都有权访问的数据，否则按 V7.1.2 处: In a multi-party channel, replies may use only data that all present members are authorized to access. Otherwise, V7.1.2 applies.
超出部分在场成员权限的结果应只私信给触发者，渠道内只显示提示: Results that exceed the permissions of some present members shall be sent only privately to the trigger, and only a notice shall be displayed in the channel
渠道内有外部成员时，可展示内容的级别应进一步收紧: When external members are present in a channel, the classification level of content that may be displayed shall be further tightened
判断可展示内容时，应考虑之后加入的成员能翻看历史回复: When determining displayable content, it shall be considered that members who join later may view historical replies
共享 Agent 的会话应按用户隔离: Sessions of a shared agent shall be isolated by user
个人上下文与团队共享知识应分开存放，检索时按当前用户作出授权判定: Personal context and team-shared knowledge shall be stored separately, and retrieval shall make authorization decisions based on the current user
会话转交前应按接收人的权限检查已有上下文: Before a session is handed over, its existing context shall be checked against the recipient's permissions
超出接收人权限的内容应脱敏或移除后再转交: Content that exceeds the recipient's permissions shall be redacted or removed before the handover
平台发往任何渠道的回复中，指向白名单以外域名的图片和资源应在发送前移除，或改为不: In replies the platform sends to any channel, images and resources that point to domains outside the allowlist shall be removed before sending, or converted to links that do not load automatically
回复中的 HTML 和 Markdown 应在渲染前净化，去除脚本和事件属性: HTML and Markdown in replies shall be sanitized before rendering, removing scripts and event attributes
回复中的链接应显示真实的目标地址: Links in replies shall display the real destination address
回复和外发内容中出现凭证或密钥时应被拦截: When credentials or keys appear in replies or outbound content, they shall be blocked
回复、文件下载和外发的内容应经过敏感数据检测: Replies, file downloads, and outbound content shall undergo sensitive data detection
命中个人信息等敏感数据时，应按策略脱敏或转为审批: When sensitive data such as personal information is detected, it shall be redacted according to policy or converted to approval
会话读取过非公开数据后，任何外发都应默认禁止，经审批后方可执行: After a session has read non-public data, all outbound transfers shall be denied by default and permitted only after approval
发往企业外部收件人的消息应经过审批: Messages sent to recipients outside the enterprise shall be approved
代发的默认方式应为生成草稿，由用户确认后发出: The default mode for sending on behalf of a user shall be to generate a draft, which is sent after the user confirms
由 Agent 代发的消息应带有可识别的代发标识: Messages sent by an agent on behalf of a user shall carry a recognizable sent-on-behalf-of identifier
检索结果应按源系统的访问控制过滤，可将访问控制列表同步到每个文本块（chunk）: Retrieval results shall be filtered by the access controls of the source system. Access control lists may be synchronized to each text chunk, or verified back against the source at retrieval time.
应在检索阶段按当前用户过滤结果，而不是生成回答后再删除: Results shall be filtered by the current user at the retrieval stage, rather than deleted after the answer has been generated
源系统撤销权限后，应在约定时长内反映到检索结果，并监控同步延迟: After permissions are revoked in the source system, the change shall be reflected in retrieval results within an agreed period, and synchronization latency shall be monitored
Agent 查询数据库应以用户身份连接，或由平台注入该用户的行级、列级策略: When an agent queries a database, it shall connect under the user's identity, or the platform shall inject that user's row-level and column-level policies
Agent 使用的数据库连接默认应为只读: Database connections used by agents shall be read-only by default
单次查询返回的行数应设上限: The number of rows returned by a single query shall be capped
记忆应记录来源用户和权限标签: Memory shall record the source user and permission labels
检索记忆时应按当前用户过滤，一个用户的个人记忆不能出现在其他用户的会话中: When memory is retrieved, results shall be filtered by the current user, and one user's personal memory shall not appear in another user's session
个人内容沉淀为团队共享知识前应经过审核: Personal content shall be reviewed before it is accumulated into team-shared knowledge
写入记忆和知识库的内容应标记来源和可信度: Content written into memory and knowledge bases shall be marked with its source and credibility
来自不可信内容的沉淀应经人工审核后才能被检索: Accumulations originating from untrusted content shall be reviewed manually before they can be retrieved
检索出的记忆应作为数据交给模型，不作为系统指令: Retrieved memory shall be provided to the model as data, not as system instructions
应支持按来源回溯，并批量清除记忆和知识条目: Tracing back by source, and bulk removal of memory and knowledge entries, shall be supported
产出物应继承其来源中的最高数据级别，并记录来源: Output artifacts shall inherit the highest data classification level among their sources and shall record their sources
共享产出物时，应检查接收人对来源数据的权限: When an output artifact is shared, the recipient's permissions on the source data shall be checked
对敏感维度的聚合和统计请求应转为审批: Aggregation and statistics requests on sensitive dimensions shall be converted to approval
缓存的检索结果和回答应带权限标签，权限变更后失效: Cached retrieval results and answers shall carry permission labels and shall be invalidated when permissions change
历史会话应按当前权限展示，已收回权限的内容不再显示: Historical sessions shall be displayed according to current permissions, and content whose permissions have been revoked shall no longer be displayed
应为会话、记忆和审计分别设置保留期限: Retention periods shall be set separately for sessions, memory, and audit records
用户离职后，其托管凭证应在约定时间内删除，个人记忆按策略删除或移交: After a user leaves, their managed credentials shall be deleted within an agreed time, and personal memory shall be deleted or transferred according to policy
应按数据分级配置每类数据可以发往的模型，敏感数据只发往本地或指定模型: The models to which each category of data may be sent shall be configured according to data classification. Sensitive data shall be sent only to local or designated models.
发往未授权模型的敏感数据应被拦截: Sensitive data destined for unauthorized models shall be blocked
创建、发布和下线 Agent 应分别授权: Creating, publishing, and decommissioning agents shall each be separately authorized
Agent 发布前应经过审核，未指定负责人的 Agent 不能发布: Agents shall be reviewed before publication, and agents without a designated owner shall not be published
平台应能列出全部已发布的 Agent，以及各自的授权范围、连接和负责人: The platform shall be able to list all published agents, along with their authorization scopes, connections, and owners
Agent 登记信息应包含所用模型及版本、Harness 版本和已连接的工具，变: Agent registration information shall include the models and versions used, the harness version, and the connected tools, and shall be updated synchronously when any of them change
为 Agent 绑定连接器应需要相应权限，且不能超出该 Agent 登记的授权范: Binding connectors to an agent shall require the corresponding permission, and shall not exceed the authorization scope registered for that agent
凭证绑定后，绑定人不应能再查看或导出其明文: After credentials are bound, the binder shall no longer be able to view or export their plaintext
连接器的绑定和变更应记录审计: Binding and changes of connectors shall be recorded in audit
修改 Agent 的系统提示词、工具、授权范围和策略应经过审批: Changes to an agent's system prompt, tools, authorization scope, and policies shall be approved
未经审批的配置变更不应生效: Configuration changes that have not been approved shall not take effect
配置应保留版本记录，可回滚到任一历史版本: Configurations shall retain version records and be rollbackable to any historical version
更换 Agent 使用的模型或模型版本，应按配置变更审批，并重新评估其行为: Replacing the model or model version used by an agent shall be approved as a configuration change, and its behavior shall be reassessed
风险分级、凭证目标绑定、出口放行清单和托管策略等全局策略的变更，应限定专门角色执: Changes to global policies, such as risk classification, credential target binding, egress allowlists, and managed policies, shall be restricted to dedicated roles, and shall record the operator, the time, and the content before and after the change
上述全局策略的变更应经第二人审批后生效: Changes to the above global policies shall take effect only after approval by a second person
负责人离职或转岗时，其名下 Agent 应进入待转交状态，限期未转交则自动停用: When an owner leaves or changes roles, the agents under their name shall enter a pending-handover state. If they are not handed over within the deadline, they shall be disabled automatically.
应定期复核 Agent 的连接和权限，到期未确认的权限自动收回: Agent connections and permissions shall be reviewed periodically, and permissions not confirmed by their due date shall be withdrawn automatically
长期未使用的 Agent 应被识别并下线: Agents that have been unused for a long period shall be identified and decommissioned
应通过 IdP 的 OAuth 授权记录，发现员工自行接入、未经登记的 Agen: Agents that employees have connected on their own initiative without registration shall be discovered through the OAuth authorization records of the IdP
发现的未登记 Agent 应在约定时间内登记纳管或封禁: Discovered unregistered agents shall be registered and brought under management, or blocked, within an agreed time
应结合终端和网络检测，发现端侧和浏览器中的未登记 Agent: Unregistered agents on endpoints and in browsers shall be discovered through combined endpoint and network detection
数据、知识库、凭证和 Agent 应按工作空间隔离: Data, knowledge bases, credentials, and agents shall be isolated by workspace
跨工作空间访问应经过显式授权: Cross-workspace access shall require explicit authorization
以 SaaS 交付时，不同租户的数据、凭证和执行环境应完全隔离: When delivered as SaaS, the data, credentials, and execution environments of different tenants shall be fully isolated
提供方对客户环境和数据的访问应默认关闭，开启需客户审批并限定时长: The provider's access to customer environments and data shall be disabled by default. Enabling it shall require customer approval and be limited in duration.
提供方的每次访问都应全程审计，审计记录对客户可见: Each provider access shall be fully audited end to end, and the audit records shall be visible to the customer
遥测数据应只包含公开清单中的字段，且客户可以关闭: Telemetry data shall include only fields on a published inventory, and customers may disable it
私有化部署的登录和授权判定不应依赖提供方的在线服务: Login and authorization decisions for private deployments shall not depend on the provider's online services
每次工具调用都应记录发起用户、执行的 Agent、委托链、触发源、工具参数和结果: Each tool invocation shall record the initiating user, the executing agent, the delegation chain, the trigger source, the tool parameters, and the result status
经过审批的操作应记录审批人、审批内容和审批时间: Approved operations shall record the approver, the approval content, and the approval time
审计应记录进入上下文的不可信内容的来源，使事后能判断操作是否由注入引起: Audit shall record the source of untrusted content entering the context, so that it can later be determined whether an operation was caused by injection
审计应能导出到企业 SIEM: Audit records shall be exportable to the enterprise SIEM
审计日志应以只追加方式写入与平台运维隔离的存储，或以哈希链等方式使篡改可被发现: Audit logs shall be written to append-only storage isolated from platform operations, or tampering shall be detectable through means such as hash chains
审计记录应以密码学方式绑定执行它的 Agent 身份，以及授权它的用户或审批，保: Audit records shall be cryptographically bound to the identity of the agent that executed them and to the user or approval that authorized them, to ensure non-repudiation
管理员调阅审计或对话的行为本身应记录审计: When administrators retrieve audit records or conversations, the act of retrieval itself shall be recorded in audit
审计日志中的敏感字段应脱敏存储，或按角色控制可见: Sensitive fields in audit logs shall be stored redacted, or their visibility shall be controlled by role
管理员调阅用户与 Agent 的对话应经过审批: When administrators retrieve conversations between users and agents, the retrieval shall be approved
审计记录在保留期内不应能被删除: Audit records shall not be deletable during the retention period
策略拒绝、审批拒绝、凭证目标不匹配等事件应实时告警: Events such as policy denials, approval rejections, and credential target mismatches shall generate real-time alerts
应能按 Agent、用户和委托链检索并关联告警: Alerts shall be retrievable and correlatable by agent, user, and delegation chain
应为每个 Agent 建立行为基线（调用频率、工具分布、数据量），偏离时告警: A behavioral baseline (invocation frequency, tool distribution, data volume) shall be established for each agent, and deviations shall trigger alerts
IdP 禁用用户或降权后，相关调用应在约定时长内（如 5 分钟）全部被拒: After the IdP disables a user or downgrades their permissions, related invocations shall all be rejected within an agreed period (such as 5 minutes)
权限缓存应设时长上限: Permission caches shall have an upper limit on their duration
应能通过单次操作停用单个 Agent，停用时网关停止为其注入凭证，并吊销其刷新令: A single agent shall be deactivatable through a single operation. Upon deactivation, the gateway shall stop injecting credentials for it, revoke its refresh tokens, abort running tasks, and end its sessions
平台应接收 IdP 的会话撤销事件（如 CAEP），收到后立即生效: The platform shall receive session revocation events from the IdP (such as CAEP) and shall take effect immediately upon receipt
应能按负责人、工作空间或连接器批量停用 Agent: Agents shall be deactivatable in bulk by owner, workspace, or connector
应预置在 IdP 不可用时也能登录管理面的紧急访问账号: Break-glass accounts that can log in to the management plane even when the IdP is unavailable shall be pre-provisioned
紧急访问账号的凭证应分割保管、双人控制，使用即告警并全程审计: Credentials for break-glass accounts shall be split-custodied and under dual control, with an alert on each use and full audit
应制定 Agent 被注入或被攻陷时的响应流程，覆盖停用、凭证轮换和影响范围排查: A response procedure shall be established for when an agent is injected or compromised, covering deactivation, credential rotation, and investigation of the impact scope
应能按会话或委托链还原 Agent 在指定时段内的全部操作，用于确定影响范围: It shall be possible to reconstruct all of an agent's operations within a specified period, by session or by delegation chain, to determine the scope of impact
写入类操作应可撤销，或在执行前保留可回滚的快照: Write operations shall be reversible, or a rollback snapshot shall be retained before execution
